about: A self-hosted nutrition tracker that runs in one container.

prs.title: Imported numbers with a thousands separator keep their value
prs.broken: Spreadsheet imports read 1,150 as 1.15, so foods saved with calories and sodium about a thousand times too low, with no error.
prs.changed: Commas that group thousands are now dropped, while small decimal commas like 1,5 and 0,125 still read as decimals.
prs.matters: Diaries brought in from a spreadsheet show the real calories.

prs.title: Lose It! imports count each food once
prs.broken: The import multiplied Lose It's calories by the logged amount, although they were already totals, so 50 g of oats counted as 9,250 kcal.
prs.changed: The logged amount is now kept as the portion, and the calories are used as they are.
prs.matters: Imported days show the same totals Lose It did.
